title.en: Caring doctors alongside mixed front desk

text.en: Most pet owners praise Dr. Butenko and the veterinary assistants for thorough clinical care and thoughtful bedside manner. Clients commend their willingness to present multiple treatment options. Conversely, a few reviewers report frustrations with rushed exams, transactional front-desk service, and delays resolving billing questions.

title.en: Detailed medical explanations with administrative gaps

text.en: Pet owners generally appreciate clear guidance from veterinarians regarding diagnostics, shot schedules, and holistic care options. However, some clients describe communication lapses, such as rapidly delivered discharge instructions, auto-populated visit notes, or repeated follow-ups required to process refunds.

Reviewers emphasize that veterinary staff demonstrate genuine compassion toward animals, including high-strung dogs and sensitive cats. Clients note that clinicians remain calm and patient during examinations and routine procedures. Multiple owners credit specialized treatments, such as acupuncture, with restoring pet mobility.

q.en: Does the clinic offer alternative treatments like acupuncture?

a.en: Yes, clients report that Dr. Butenko provides acupuncture therapies that have helped pets regain mobility and comfort.

q.en: Is parking readily available near the clinic?

a.en: Reviewers note that street parking is generally accessible along Chicago Avenue in front of the practice.

q.en: How does the team handle anxious or high-strung animals?

a.en: Owners report that the veterinary staff is gentle and patient, helping nervous dogs and cats feel settled during exams.
